newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-WBA SACK BUCKLEY AFTER DISAPPOINTING SLUMP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-WBA SACK BUCKLEY AFTER DISAPPOINTING SLUMP.

text.p: West Bromwich Albion manager Alan Buckley was sacked on Wednesday after a poor run of results which saw his team tumble to 17th in the English first division.

Buckley, who was manager of Grimsby for six years before taking over at the Hawthorns in October 1994, was told recently by chairman Tony Hale that results had to improve following the club's proposed flotation on the stock market.
In a statement on Wednesday Hale said: "Alan worked very hard for the club and everyone wishes him well in the future."
Buckley's assistant Arthur Mann becomes caretaker-manager.
